#!/bin/sh
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
black>format.log
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
black<input.py
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
black&next
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
black|next
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
ruff format>format.log
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
ruff format<input.py
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
ruff format&&next
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
ruff format||next
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
prettier --write>format.log
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
prettier -w<input.css
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
prettier --write&&next
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
prettier -w||next
# ruleid: lintro.scripts.no-direct-formatter.native-command
prettier>format.log --write a.css
